MUS.note: The FAIR guidelines are guidance to evolve into regulations later, not a rule in force or a draft rule.
Nothing on AI used in a government body.
Only an intention that FAIR guidelines will evolve into AI Regulations; no draft is named.
Nothing on AI in a sector's public system.

facts.fact: The Prime Minister's Office states that Cabinet agreed on 13 February 2026 to adopt the AI strategy 'AI for Mauritius' as the national guiding policy framework for AI.

MUS.note: Nothing on AI models, datasets or computing built in the country.

facts.fact: The Prime Minister's Office states that citizens must register through the MauPass authentication platform to use the KOREK! driving licence points app, which is in service.
